indicators.label: Census population total
indicators.description: Present usual residents represented in the atoll religion table.
indicators.method: Printed atoll total: 2006 Table 2.5; 2011 and 2016 Table 5.8.
indicators.quality_notes: Present-resident universe (present in Tokelau on census night), not the absentee-inclusive usual-resident total.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share of the atoll population with a stated religious affiliation.
indicators.method: 100 * (Total - No religion - Not stated) / Total; affiliation includes every named denomination and Spiritualism and New Age religions.
indicators.quality_notes: Percentages use each atoll's printed present-usual-resident total. Religious affiliation is every named denomination plus Spiritualism and New Age religions; No religion and Not stated are excluded from the affiliation numerator. 2006 prints no No religion line and its analytical report records that every respondent gave a Christian denomination, so no religion is zero across the three 2006 atolls.

indicators.label: No religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share in the source No religion category (zero for 2006, which prints no such line).
indicators.method: 100 * No religion / Total. 2006: zero (no No religion line; every respondent gave a Christian denomination).
indicators.quality_notes: Tokelau is effectively universally Christian: the national no-religion count is 0, 0, and 1 across 2006, 2011, and 2016.
